test.create_query: CREATE TABLE cosine_distance_const (id UInt64, bf16 Array(BFloat16), f32 Array(Float32)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO cosine_distance_const SELECT number, CAST(v AS Array(BFloat16)), CAST(v AS Array(Float32)) FROM (SELECT number, arrayMap(i -> sin(number * 0.001 + i * 0.37), range(768)) AS v FROM numbers(300000)) SETTINGS max_block_size = 8192, max_insert_block_size = 65536, min_insert_block_size_rows = 65536
test.query: SELECT sum(cosineDistance(bf16, arrayMap(i -> cos(i), range(768)))) FROM cosine_distance_const
SELECT sum(cosineDistance(bf16, CAST(arrayMap(i -> cos(i), range(768)) AS Array(BFloat16)))) FROM cosine_distance_const
SELECT sum(cosineDistance(f32, arrayMap(i -> cos(i), range(768)))) FROM cosine_distance_const
SELECT sum(cosineDistance(f32, CAST(arrayMap(i -> cos(i), range(768)) AS Array(Float32)))) FROM cosine_distance_const
